# MyBib

> > MyBib is a free, comprehensive citation generator supporting 10+ academic styles including APA, MLA, Harvard, Chicago, and specialized formats for science and engineering.

MyBib provides instant citation generation and formatting guides for students and academics across multiple citation styles. The platform supports APA 7th Edition, MLA 8th and 9th Editions, Harvard, Chicago, IEEE, Vancouver, ACS, AMA, CSE, and Turabian formats with integrated search functionality and detailed how-to guides.

## Citation Generators

- [MyBib – A New FREE APA, Harvard, & MLA Citation Generator](https://www.mybib.com): MyBib homepage: free citation generator for APA, MLA, Harvard, Chicago styles
- [Free APA Citation Generator [Updated for 2026]](https://www.mybib.com/tools/apa-citation-generator): APA citation generator supporting APA 7th Edition with keyword/URL search
- [Free MLA Citation Generator [Updated for 2026]](https://www.mybib.com/tools/mla-citation-generator): MLA citation generator supporting 8th and 9th Edition with Works Cited
- [Free Harvard Referencing Generator [Updated for 2026]](https://www.mybib.com/tools/harvard-referencing-generator): Harvard referencing generator for books, websites, journals, and more
- [Free Chicago Citation Generator [Updated for 2026]](https://www.mybib.com/tools/chicago-citation-generator): Chicago style citation generator for 17th edition formatting
- [Free Works Cited Generator [Updated for 2026]](https://www.mybib.com/tools/works-cited-generator): Works Cited page generator for MLA 8th and 9th Edition formats

## Specialized Citation Styles

- [Free IEEE Citation Generator [Updated for 2026]](https://www.mybib.com/tools/ieee-citation-generator): IEEE citation generator for engineering and electronics citations
- [Free Vancouver Citation Generator [Updated for 2026]](https://www.mybib.com/tools/vancouver-citation-generator): Vancouver citation generator for biomedical and medical citations
- [Free ACS Citation Generator [Updated for 2026]](https://www.mybib.com/tools/acs-citation-generator): ACS citation generator for American Chemical Society style citations
- [Free AMA Citation Generator [Updated for 2026]](https://www.mybib.com/tools/ama-citation-generator): AMA citation generator for American Medical Association style citations
- [Free CSE Citation Generator [Updated for 2026]](https://www.mybib.com/tools/cse-citation-generator): CSE citation generator for Council of Science Editors style citations
- [Free Turabian Citation Generator [Updated for 2026]](https://www.mybib.com/tools/turabian-citation-generator): Turabian citation generator for Chicago-based academic writing

## Formatting Guides & Tutorials

- [The Complete Guide to APA Format in 2026](https://www.mybib.com/guides/apa-format): Complete APA Format guide with interactive examples and APA 7th Edition
- [How to cite a textbook in APA format](https://www.mybib.com/answers/how-to-cite-a-textbook-in-apa-style): Guide to citing textbooks in APA 7 style with examples
- [How to cite a YouTube video](https://www.mybib.com/answers/how-to-cite-a-youtube-video): How-to guide for citing YouTube videos in APA, MLA, and Harvard
- [How to cite a movie in APA, MLA, or Harvard style](https://www.mybib.com/answers/how-to-cite-a-movie): Guide to citing movies in APA, MLA, and Harvard formats
